name: Spirit-Thread Divination
summary: Hang a pendulum over a thing and ask it one small question.
flavour: The thread swings against its own weight, and the answer arrives before the question finishes.

name: Augur's Glance
summary: Things that would answer a divination catch at the corner of your eye.
flavour: Something in the room declines to be ordinary.

name: Sleight of Hand
summary: Locks, latches and other people's pockets open for you.
flavour: Your fingers do something you did not instruct them to do, and the catch gives.

name: Misdirection
summary: Every eye in the room goes to the wrong place for as long as you need.
flavour: They all look left. You were never on the left.

name: Mocking Barb
summary: A jibe pitched precisely at the thing they are hiding.
flavour: You say the one sentence they have been rehearsing against, and their rehearsal falls apart.

name: Paper Mask
summary: A borrowed bearing and an unremarkable face. Nobody recalls you clearly.
flavour: You adjust nothing, and become somebody who was always meant to be standing here.

name: Stage Presence
summary: You occupy the room. Answers come out fuller than intended.
flavour: The air arranges itself around you, and they find themselves explaining.

name: Conjurer's Reach
summary: The prop you need is in your hand, and was always in your hand.
flavour: You produce the key. It is warm, as though it has been in your pocket for hours.

name: Borrowed Face
summary: Become someone they already trust. Doors open for the face, not for you.
flavour: You put on their face, and their name comes with it, and for a moment you have to check which one you answer to.

name: Hollow Step
summary: Walk out of a room that is trying very hard to keep you.
flavour: You are not there. The interval where you were there closes behind you.

name: Read the Room
summary: Every lie in earshot announces itself.
flavour: Their words go on. Underneath them you can hear the shape of what is not being said.

name: Steady the Thread
summary: Take hold of your own spirit body and stop it shaking.
flavour: You find the loose end of yourself and wind it back in.

name: Read the Cards
summary: Perform the role in earnest — the acting method, done on purpose.
flavour: You lay them out for a stranger and tell them something true, and mean every word of it.

name: Take the Temperature
summary: Ask the street how much of it is thinking about you.
flavour: You listen past the traffic, and the city answers with a number you feel rather than hear.

name: Unmarked
summary: Shed whatever it is that makes a face worth remembering.
flavour: Somebody looks straight at you and forgets, halfway through, what they were looking at.
